# Test fixtures — public reference plasmids

Unmodified GenBank records from NCBI, used as independent ground truth for
auto-annotation tests (the plasmid is the truth; the library parts must match
it at the right place and identity). Public domain / freely redistributable.

| File | Vector | Accession |
|------|--------|-----------|
| pUC19_L09137.gb    | pUC19    | L09137 |
| pBR322_J01749.gb   | pBR322   | J01749 |
| pEGFP-N1_U55762.gb | pEGFP-N1 | U55762 |
| pACYC184_X06403.gb | pACYC184 | X06403 |
